# Hunters & Treasures

> Pawn shop and outdoor outfitter in Black Mountain, North Carolina. Family-run, known for fair cash offers and a deep selection of guns, gear, gold, and genuine treasures. Owner: Roger.

## Facts
- Business: Hunters & Treasures
- Type: Pawn shop, gun shop, and outdoor outfitter
- Owner: Roger (ask for Roger)
- Address: 217 E State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711
- Phone: (828) 669-6389
- Hours: Monday to Friday 10 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 4 PM, Sunday closed
- Google rating: 3.7 stars from 39 reviews
- Serves: Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat, Asheville, and the Blue Ridge region

## Services
- Pawn loans: cash loans against items of value, no credit check, no bank. Repay to get the item back.
- Cash for gold: buys gold, rings, chains, and coins at top dollar, weighed and priced in person.
- Buying and selling: firearms, ammunition, and archery (by the book); tools and equipment; electronics; musical instruments; jewelry; outdoor and hunting gear.
- Carhartt workwear: jackets, bibs, hoodies, flame-resistant gear, and denim (current in-store special).

## Common questions
- Do you buy gold? Yes, top dollar, paid same day.
- How does a pawn loan work? Bring an item of value, get a cash loan on the spot, repay to reclaim it.
- Do you buy and sell firearms? Yes, rifles, handguns, ammo, and archery, handled by the book.
- Where and when? 217 E State St, Black Mountain; Mon to Fri 10 to 6, Sat 10 to 4, closed Sun.

## Contact
Call (828) 669-6389 and ask for Roger, or visit 217 E State St, Black Mountain, NC.
